Reading this dashboard
attributes.visState:
{"title":"Reading this dashboard","type":"markdown","params":{"fontSize":14,"openLinksInNewTab":true,"markdown":"### Reading this dashboard
- **Debug panels:** enable `Logging__EcsHttp__LogLevel__ImagingPipeline.UnifiedGateway=Debug` for delivered dispatches, filter decisions and refresh snapshots. An empty panel can mean missing telemetry rather than zero activity.
- **Sampling and retries:** traces may be sampled; logs may be filtered/dropped; retries repeat attempts. Distinct-image counts are approximate.
- **Environment:** a runtime field normalizes `Integration` and `integration`. Pipeline and instance names come from actual documents.
- **Time and cost:** start with one environment and one hour. Refresh is paused by default. Normalization reads runtime fields; broad ranges across many traces cost more.
- **Signals:** this dashboard uses logs and raw APM traces. Queue depth, CPU and exporter-drop metrics remain in Prometheus.
- **Trace links:** target the Space selected when generating the import; APM must be enabled there."},"aggs":[]}
